value.rationale: The scalar fading-memory equation is the natural linear stability probe for the published high-order Volterra discretization. The exact frontier detects a qualitative failure — unconditional asymptotic damping of a true exponentially growing physical mode — for every nonzero timestep on a nonempty interval, with exact sharp condition and asymptotic behavior. This supplies a motivated benchmark and is not a routine restatement of a generic sufficient bound.
